page.overview:
Who is Blood?

Blood is a large muscular man whose arms are remodeled and enhanced, looking unnaturally big and dark as a result. Scumocide's right hand man, Blood stands as the leader of the operation on Earth. In the SNES port his name was changed to Boots.

Blood fights by performing powerful kicks and a fast flying kick maneuver that covers the whole screen.
